text:
Introduction
It is a Layer 3 1G/10G Hybrid rate Managed Ethernet Switch featuring
seamless connection for 10/100/1000M Ethernet
with LED indicators to display the connection and operation of equipment
easy to manage and maintain
It can be  used as core layer, distribution layer, and access layer switch for various business network applications
Key Features
4*1G/2.5G/10G SFP+ uplink slots + 24*10/100/1000M RJ45 ports and 1*RJ45 console port for basic management and setup
Layer 3 features: Support static and dynamic routing, RIP, OSPF, BGP4,ECMP, VRRP
Port aggregation: Support GE ports, 2.5GE and 10GE port aggregation, static and dynamic aggregation
VLAN : Support access, truck , hybrid mode and VLAN classification, including the Mac based VLAN, IP based VLAN and protocol based VLAN
QinQ: Support port-based, VLAN-based and flow-based QinQ
Port Mirroring: Many to one port mirroring
Layer 2 ring network protocol: Support STP, RSTP, MSTP, G.8032 ERPS protocol, single ring, sub ring
Multicast: Support IGMP snooping
QoS: QoS class, remarking, Support SP, WRR queue scheduling, Ingress/Engress port-based rate-limit and policy-based QoS
Security: Support Dot1x, port authentication, mac authentication, RADIUS service
Support port-security, ip source guard, IP/Port/MAC binding, arp-check and ARP packet filtering for illegal users and port isolation
Management: Support LLDP, user management and login authentication; SNMPV1/V2C/V3; web management, HTTP1.1, HTTPS; Syslog; RMON(Remote Monitoring)alarm, event and history record; NTP, temperature monitoring; Ping, Tracert and optical transceiver DDM function; Support TFTP Client, Telnet Server, SSH Server and IPv6 Management
Firmware update, configure backup/restore through Web UI, FTP and TFTP
Specification
Product Name	28 Port Hybrid Rate Rack Type Managed Ethernet Switch
Port	24*10/100/1000M UTP RJ45 / 4*10G SFP+ Ports / 1*RJ45 Console Port(115200,8,N,1)
Network Protocol	IEEE 802.3 10Base-T Ethernet / IEEE 802.3u 100Base-TX Ethernet / IEEE 802.3ab 1000Base-T Ethernet / IEEE 802.3z 1000Base-X Ethernet / IEEE802.3x Flow Control and Back Pressure / IEEE 802.1D Spanning Tree Protocol / IEEE 802.1w Rapid Spanning Tree Protocol / IEEE 802.1Q VLAN / ITU-T G.8032 ERPS / IEEE 802.1X Port Authentication Network Control / IEEE 802.1ab LLDP / IEEE 802.3ad LACP
Fiber Option	SFP Plug-able Module(LC), 1G , 2.5G or 10G based / Default speed is 10G, 1G or 2.5G speed needs to be manually configured in the Web UI / It is NOT supporting auto-detecting, manual configuration is required / It is NOT supporting 100M optical module nor configurable / SM: 1310nm/1550nm, 20Km; 1490nm/1550nm, 40~100Km / MM: 1310nm, 2Km; 850nm, 500-meter
Switching Capacity	128Gbps
Packet Forwarding Rate	190.4Mpps
MAC Address Table	16K
VLAN	4K
Buffer	12Mbit
Forwarding Delay	<5us
Jumbo Frame	Support 10Kbytes
MDX/MIDX	Support
Power	AC100-240V Input, Single Power Input(default) / Dual Power Input is optional, support fan monitoring/dual PSU status monitoring / Fan monitoring: support normal/failure mode / Fan speed: support high/low speed mode, configuring fan speed is NOT supported
Total power Consumption	Full loading≤25W
Over-current Protection	Support
Watchdog	Support
MTBF	100,000 hours
Certification	CE/FCC/RoHS/Reach/UKCA
Working Environment	Working Temperature: 0℃~50℃ / Storage Temperature: -10℃~70℃ / Working Humidity: 10%~90%, non-condensing / Storage Temperature: 5%~95%, non-condensing
LED Indicator	PWR(Power indicator) / On: power status is normal
Off: power off or power connection failure / S(System indicator) / On: Normal operation / Off: Connection failure / Blinking: Device initialization / Ethernet Port / Green Indicator / On: port link up / Off: port link down / Blinking: data is in normal transmission / Yellow Indicator / On: port speed is 1000M / Off: port speed is 10/100M / Fiber port, Green Color / On: port link up / Off: port link down / Blinking: data is in normal transmission
Packing Information
1pc switch(neutral device)
1pc power cable(standards vary across countries)
1pc user manual(including QIG information)
1pc console cable(USB 2.0 to RJ45 connector)
1pair mounting brackets(rack mountable)
Please know that there is NOT a warranty card in the packing box
A “Warranty Certificate” will be issued to indicate the order information and warranty coverage
Shipping box information(Below information is approximately accurate)
Product size: 440*245*44mm
Inner box size: 525*390*95mm
Product weight: 2.8Kg
Packing weight: 3.4Kg
Master box size: 545*495*420mm
Packing quantity: 5Pcs
Packing weight: 21Kg
Remark
Accessories(Optical module, network cable, patchcord etc.)are NOT included in the packing box
Please prepare it by yourself or purchase a whole set from us
Power cable is included in BOTH the packing box AND unit pricing

Above changes are free of cost(even for 1 piece only)
